notTokenised.css-custom-properties: www.sketch.com declares --rotationAmount and --swiper-theme-color on the homepage stylesheets. Neither is a design-system colour or type role. --swiper-theme-color resolved to #007aff and is Swiper's default, not a Sketch accent.
notTokenised.dark-theme: Not captured. No dark class or attribute is bound on the public pages that loaded.
notTokenised.success-warning-danger-info: Not captured. No status colour role was painted on the public pages measured.
notTokenised.focus-ring: Not captured as a distinct token. focus-visible on the header link and primary button did not change outline or box-shadow in the computed style.
notTokenised.pressed-colour: Not captured as a colour. CDP :active on the primary button scaled the box (157.95x47 to 153.21x45.59) and did not change the fill.
notTokenised.spacing-scale: Not captured. No spacing custom properties. Padding is recorded per component.
notTokenised.motion: Not captured as tokens. Durations were not read into a scale.
notTokenised.elevation-scale: Not captured as a scale. Individual box-shadows stay in the component readings.
notTokenised.nav-menu: Not captured. The Product disclosure did not stay visible long enough for a crop in measure.mjs. The open menu is in screenshots/home-light-nav-product.png.
